submitter_note: Brooks Arcand-Paul, MLA for Edmonton-West Henday
community: Enoch Cree Nation; Stoney Nakoda (three nations), Tsuu T'ina, O'Chiese, Sunchild; First Nations and Métis of northern Alberta (Mackenzie)
request: keep the interim map's arrangements: Enoch Cree Nation in the Edmonton riding Edmonton-West-Enoch, the three Stoney Nakoda nations with Tsuu T'ina, O'Chiese and Sunchild together in Banff-Jasper, and a Mackenzie riding giving northern First Nations and Métis a distinct voice
quote: Edmonton-West-Enoch gives Enoch Cree Nation an opportunity to access effective representation. Enoch Cree Nation is unique because it’s a highly urban First Nation.
note: Endorses interim placements rather than asking for a change. Second quote: 'in bringing together the three Stoney Nakoda nations along with the Tsuu T’ina Nation and O’Chiese and Sunchild First Nations in Banff-Jasper, you have given them the opportunity to be better supported by a singular MLA' (EB-803). Says Enoch in Drayton Valley-Devon had voices 'drowned out in a largely rural riding'. In answer to Mr. Clark: has not spoken to Enoch chief and council; some members support inclusion in the urban riding; nations told him they were never consulted on inclusion in urban ridings or Banff-Jasper. Record does not state he is a member of a nation, so coded non_member (MLA). Could also be read as keep_nations_together for the Banff-Jasper grouping.
